# SimpleFOC (Arduino-FOC) 2.4.0, unmodified

Origin: https://github.com/simplefoc/Arduino-FOC, `library.properties` version 2.4.0, commit `b3d8f3931342ae68a980d0140e24b9048eba098b` (2026-10-04), fetched 2026-11-03. License: MIT (`arduino-foc/LICENSE`). SimpleFOC lists no TI target.

Kept: `src/` (the motor, driver, sensor, filter and PID classes) and the licence. Left out: the examples, the Commander and step/direction listener, every `hardware_specific/` folder except `generic_mcu.cpp` (the board-support code for other chips), the README, the CI folder and the logo. No kept file is edited; `SHA256SUMS` lists them. Used by `ports/simplefoc/`, which supplies the chip layer.
